# Independent review: exact Mellin divisor interface

Date: 2026-09-17.
Reviewer: `/root/pairzero_geometry_review`.
Verdict: **ACCEPT_EXACT_MELLIN_SHIFT_DIVISOR_AND_SEPARATION_CONTROL_ONLY**.

## Exact binding and sources

Candidate: `KPS_MELLIN_DIVISOR_AUDIT.md`.
SHA256: `12a28c6fc8745f4762ad8d70b6b5458d7715465e9704792eed0f07e11325a7e3`.
Size: 7179 bytes, 156 LF. The final candidate was read completely.
Base declared by candidate: `98722205a0b57689fc7756c74537c9fe0c597bac`.

Both pinned project sources were directly reread completely and their hashes
verified in the isolated gamma-reciprocity checkout:

- `REPORT_2026-09-17_KPS_FORCED_QUOTIENT.md`:
  `8b5cc3a609cf73ef977ee67c6036e5cfaef6294d496f9b0f78f6ba847558f1ff`.
- `REPORT_2026-09-17_KPS_MOMENT_INTERFACE.md`:
  `8db1503625708a8271f63ea9b1ff33ed5d38ecbe131718ab152688b322e528a0`.

The pinned KPS journal PDF hash was verified:
`05f75d661af5d94d64c5c66b6a9c1ee22a73d53e13c5afd8ceb7a76a5cf14a19`.
The local extract hash is
`3905256eb366d14d6dd0cad34b57bbc5e95325f29da33630c6777cab6c632cb5`.
Printed pp395-397 were read, including definition (4.14) and Theorem 4.4
on p396. Its meromorphic separation condition really requires the stated
unit zero-to-pole offset, not merely real interlacing or Pick membership.
The unresolved xi discussion on p397 is not imported as a source theorem.

## S1: analytic continuation and the exact shift

The actual series
r(t) = sum_n (4 pi^2 n^4 t - 6 pi n^2) exp(-pi n^2 t)
is normally convergent near t=1: on each compact subset of Re(t)>0,
each term is bounded by a fixed polynomial in n times exp(-c n^2).
Consequently its composition exp(5x/2) r(exp(2x)) is holomorphic near
x=0. Its proved real evenness implies local complex evenness by the identity
theorem. Dividing by the positive L1 normalization and collecting the even
powers yields a convergent local power series for rho(s). No entire
extension of Phi or rho has been assumed here.

The Mellin continuation in (S1) is valid. The tail integral starting at
fixed epsilon>0 is entire in u; the complete positive-axis source decay
bounds each fixed power and every power of log(s), uniformly on compact
u-sets. The Taylor remainder is O(s^M), giving local uniform convergence
and holomorphy on Re(u)>-M-1/2. The explicit finite correction has residue
a_k at u=-k-1/2. Agreement on the original half-plane patches these
continuations uniquely. They cover C, and there are no possible other
poles or poles of order greater than one.

Multiplication by the entire reciprocal Gamma(u+1/2) therefore removes
all possible poles of D. Since the residue of Gamma at -k is (-1)^k/k!,
the finite value is exactly H(-k-1/2)=(-1)^k k! a_k. When a_k=0,
D is regular there and the reciprocal-Gamma zero forces H to vanish.
Conjugation of the original integral, followed by analytic continuation,
makes H real on the real axis. H is not identically zero because D and
Gamma are positive on the original positive real domain.

For Re(u)>1/2, integration by parts gives
N(u)=(u-1/2)D(u-1). The boundary at zero vanishes because rho is bounded
and Re(u-1/2)>0; the full tail bounds pay the other boundary and both
integrals. Combining Gamma(u+1/2)=(u-1/2)Gamma(u-1/2) gives
N(u)=Gamma(u+1/2)H(u-1), and hence phi_*(u)=4H(u-1)/H(u).
This last equation is an identity of meromorphic functions on C. On
Re(u)>-1/2 it coincides meromorphically with the previously defined 4N/D.
It assigns no pointwise value to an unresolved zero divided by zero.

Moreover N/Gamma(u+1/2) is holomorphic on Re(u)>-1/2 and agrees with
H(u-1) on Re(u)>1/2. The identity theorem extends their equality to that
whole original domain. For real v>-3/2 the numerator N(v+1) is strictly
positive by the full decreasing profile and the integral definition, and
Gamma(v+3/2)>0. Thus H(v)>0 on precisely the stated open real interval.
This is not a zero-free complex half-plane.

The initial candidate also asserted H(-3/2)>0 using strict curvature at
zero without a precise locator among its two named inputs. That assertion
was not needed: strict decrease and strict squared-coordinate concavity
alone do not guarantee rho'(0)<0. The final candidate removes the endpoint
claim. The accepted proof is consequently independent of an extra origin
curvature premise. No endpoint issue remains in the final bytes.

## S2: divisor accounting

For nonzero entire H, local factorization at z and z-1 immediately gives
ord_z(phi_*) = m(z-1) - m(z). This is exact, including multiplicities and
all numerator/denominator cancellation. For a simple zero t with
H(t-1)H(t+1) nonzero, the quotient has a pole at t and a zero at t+1.
A chain of consecutive H zeros instead cancels the internal factors.
Neither the identity nor the divisor subtraction proves that the surviving
zeros and poles are real, simple or globally ordered, nor that their
separation satisfies the primary paper's condition. Those scope statements
are correct. This is divisor bookkeeping, not a sign mechanism for V.

## S3: complete check of the explicit different-source control

Write P(s)=s^2+3s+15/4. Gaussian moments give
integral_R exp(-x^2)P(x^2)dx = sqrt(pi)(3/4+3/2+15/4)
=6sqrt(pi), so the specified q_c has probability mass one. It is positive
and even, with rapid decay. Direct differentiation yields
rho_c'=-exp(-s)(s^2+s+3/4)<0 and
(log rho_c)''=-(2s^2+6s+3/2)/P(s)^2<0 for s>=0.
Thus the positive planar Abel construction applies to this full profile;
its overall normalization cancels in the quotient. This does not assert
that this profile has the actual theta source's additive PF structure.

The convergent Mellin integral for Re(u)>-1/2 is
Gamma(u+5/2)+3Gamma(u+3/2)+(15/4)Gamma(u+1/2).
Factoring Gamma(u+1/2) leaves
(u+1/2)(u+3/2)+3(u+1/2)+15/4=(u+2)(u+3).
Hence the normalized H_c differs from (u+2)(u+3) only by a positive
constant, and the quotient reduces exactly to 4(u+1)/(u+3).

Its Levy representation is correct: the integral is 1/3-1/(u+3), so
4/3+8 times that integral equals 4-8/(u+3). The positive finite Levy
measure 8exp(-3t)dt and nonnegative constant show it is Bernstein.
The holomorphic upper-half-plane continuation satisfies
Im(phi_c(z))=8 Im(z)/|z+3|^2>0, proving Pick as well. Its sole surviving
zero and pole are -1 and -3. Therefore rho_1=z_1-1 fails: the actual
difference is two. Explicitly, the H zero at -2 cancels between shifted
numerator and denominator, leaving the ends of the chain. This is a valid
failure of B_P1 at separation despite full Bernstein and Pick properties.

For the Fourier transform, the Gaussian identities contribute
x^2: 1/2-z^2/4 and x^4: 3/4-3z^2/4+z^4/16, each multiplied by
sqrt(pi)exp(-z^2/4). Combining x^4+3x^2+15/4 and dividing by
6sqrt(pi) gives exactly exp(-z^2/4)(1-z^2/4+z^4/96).
The polynomial equation in y=z^2 is y^2-24y+96=0, hence
y=12 plus or minus 4sqrt(3), both positive. Its four zeros are real
and simple; the exponential has none. No numerical evidence is needed.
Thus the example really has real Fourier zeros while the fixed quotient
fails the particular KPS separation condition. It is not a negative-V
witness, a claim about theta membership, or a refutation of other routes.

## Final scope

All S1-S3 claims in the exact final candidate stand. The source-derived
shift identity and continuation are useful interface facts; their divisor
formula does not prove Pick membership or the KPS unit separation. The
explicit control prevents conflating a unit shift with a surviving unit
gap. Actual theta Bernstein/Pick/separation membership and the sign of
original full V and RH remain unresolved by this note.

This is only an isolated PAPER audit. The review does not validate live job
status, perform a competing proof dispatch, modify canonical controls, reset
any counter, publish artifacts, or make a canonical/Lean admission. Only
this reviewer-owned staging file was written.

# Parent check: gamma-normalized Mellin divisor

Final candidate SHA256: 12a28c6fc8745f4762ad8d70b6b5458d7715465e9704792eed0f07e11325a7e3.

S1: Local theta series converges normally in a disk about t=1 in Re(t)>0;
composition with exp(2x) and evenness provide a convergent rho series near
s=0. For its M-term subtraction, the Mellin remainder behaves as
s^(Re u+M-1/2), integrable precisely for Re u>-M-1/2. The finite subtraction
has simple poles with residues a_k. Reciprocal Gamma has simple zeros at
those locations with derivative (-1)^k k!, proving the H values and entire
continuation. The tail integral is entire because its lower endpoint is
positive and the source pays every positive power and logarithm at infinity.
For Re u>1/2, the N integration by parts has zero lower boundary and pays
N=(u-1/2)D(u-1). Gamma recurrence gives exactly phi=4H(u-1)/H(u), with
meromorphic continuation, including canceled points. The alternative
H(u-1)=N(u)/Gamma(u+1/2) extends to Re u>-1/2, so its real values are positive
for v=u-1>-3/2. The unused strict endpoint claim was removed following the
reviewer's request for a direct source pin. No endpoint value is needed.

S2: Translation does not change multiplicity, so the numerator order at z
is m(z-1), denominator order is m(z), and their difference is the quotient's
order. A unit chain cancels at interior locations; hence identifying the
formal shift with a gap in the surviving divisor would be wrong.

S3: Gaussian moments give integral exp(-x²)(x⁴+3x²+15/4)dx
=sqrt(pi)(3/4+3/2+15/4)=6sqrt(pi). P'=2s+3 and P''=2 give
2P-(P')²=-2s²-6s-3/2<0, while P'-P=-s²-s-3/4<0. The Mellin polynomial is
(u+1/2)(u+3/2)+3(u+1/2)+15/4=u²+5u+6. Its shift ratio reduces to
(u+1)/(u+3). The Levy integral is 8(1/3-1/(u+3)); adding 4/3 gives
4-8/(u+3). Its imaginary part is 8 Im u/|u+3|². Thus positivity, all
Bernstein signs and the Pick mapping are actual properties of this control.
The two surviving divisor locations -1 and -3 fail the specific unit-gap
hypothesis, although the original H shift was precisely one unit.

Fourier transform: writing G(z)=exp(-z²/4), one has
G''=(z²/4-1/2)G and G''''=(z⁴/16-3z²/4+3/4)G. Therefore
(G''''-3G''+(15/4)G)/6=(1-z²/4+z⁴/96)G. Solving the quadratic in z² gives
12+-4sqrt(3), both positive. No other zeros occur since G is zero-free.
This is not a theta counterexample; it shows even the KPS separation failure
need not obstruct real Fourier zeros. Original V's sign is not asserted.

The report is an interface audit complementary to the live request, not an
additional dispatch or an unverified assertion of actual class membership.
accepted: Actual D has meromorphic continuation and H=D/Gamma(u+1/2) is entire
Forced phi=4H(u-1)/H(u) and its exact divisor orders account for all cancellations
Actual H is positive for real u>-3/2; no complex zero-free domain is claimed
Explicit different-source positive Abel/log-concave control has Bernstein-Pick phi with gap2 yet all Fourier zeros real
